description: This file defines a PHP class or script for a subpanel view related to Prospect Lists in a CRM system, including UI components and interactions for managing prospect lists within campaigns.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views within the CRM, managing templates, assignments, and display of list data.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new XTemplate object with a specified template file and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the list view header.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the HTML content below the header, typically buttons and controls.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data, main identifier, and mode.
